text:
tara: did a first-pass bring-up for cinder-embed-v1 on docs+wiki holdouts. recall@10 is lower than ember-baseline. need quick sanity checks.

noah: numbers?

tara: short table from smoke:
baseline ember-v1 | cosine r@10 = 0.796
cinder-embed-v1 raw | cosine r@10 = 0.741
cinder-embed-v1 normed| cosine r@10 = 0.789
cinder-embed-v1 int8 pc| cosine r@10 = 0.759
(holdout combined ~45k)

mica: normalization closes most of the gap. verify index/query preprocessing parity. also check length stddev pre/post quant.

ash: also watch silhouette & purity: baseline sil=0.427, cinder_raw=0.298, cinder_norm=0.412. purity@10 follows similar pattern.

tara: root cause looks like missing L2-normalize in our indexer for this model. prepping rerun with normalize=true and int8 per-channel ablation.

eval-bot: job created: 4801122334-job1, artifacts: /artifacts/4801122334/cinder-smoke.json

noah: run whitening ablation too (pca_whiten with 64 comps) in parallel, sometimes helps news/docs.

mica: if int8 per-channel drops >0.03 we can try calibration scale factor or fallback to int6 compaction. but prefer per-channel first.

tara: commands for reproducibility:
python eval/recall.py --model cinder-embed-v1 --holdout 45000 --normalize True --quant per-channel --out /tmp/cinder-rerun.json
python eval/recall.py --model cinder-embed-v1 --holdout 45000 --normalize True --whiten 64 --out /tmp/cinder-whiten.json

ash: filing INF-4210 to add a CI smoke that asserts normalization parity for new embed models (tiny synthetic recall 5k).

tara: quick update (18m): normalized rerun -> cosine r@10 = 0.790, silhouette=0.415, purity@10=0.80. int8 per-channel in progress.

mica: nice. once int8 numbers land, summarize and we'll decide whether to proceed with onboarding or iterate on quant config.

tara: will post final int8 artifact here. thanks all! :raised_hands:
